title: Tilt-Shift Miniature — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Near route in focus
scenes.purpose: Establish the fixed high view of a miniature town with a narrow sharp band on the foreground street and the moving blue van as the first subject while the idea hub lights up.
visuals: Fixed high-angle Three.js town: green ground, three streets, houses, instanced trees, parked cars, lamps and people as scale clues
Narrow depth-of-field band on the near street; background and foreground blurred by depth
Glowing idea hub at the crossroads with an expanding amber pulse
Amber arcs grow from the hub to three near houses

beats.development: Title card settles top-left outside the focus band; the hub brightens and pulses; the blue van starts along the in-focus foreground street.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Arcs grow from the hub to three near houses and their nodes pop in; the van slows to a stop beside its house; the far cream truck enters on the blurred far street.

scenes.title: Focus pull to the far route
scenes.purpose: Pull focus along the route from the near van to the far truck by keyframing the world focus distance, so the sharp strip climbs through the hub to the far street.
visuals: Focus distance eases from the near-street depth to the far-street depth
Sharp band crosses the hub plaza mid-pull; the van softens as the truck sharpens
Far arcs begin growing toward the far houses

beats.development: Keyframed focus distance travels from the foreground route to the far route; blur stays tied to depth while the truck drives toward its house and far links start drawing.

scenes.title: Connected system
scenes.purpose: Resolve on the far subject in focus with every house linked to the idea hub, and hold the settled frame.
visuals: Truck stops on the sharp far street
All six arcs and nodes complete
Second hub pulse marks the completed system
Progress bar on the card completes in the active blue

beats.development: Far nodes pop in, the truck settles at its house and a second pulse spreads from the hub.
Settled hold: far street sharp, near street soft, the full network and title card readable.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Focus pull begins only after the near subject has stopped and the far subject is moving into meaning, per the style's timing rule.
All motion is settled by 2.45 s, leaving a clean hold before 2.7 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.6–3.0 s settled hold so the focus result and the title remain readable.

notes: Demonstrates the catalogue characteristic action: pull focus along a foreground route from one moving subject to a second at a different depth. No reviewed preview recipes were supplied.
Camera is fixed; geometry scale is constant; only focus distance, vehicles, arcs, hub glow and the card are animated from one paused GSAP timeline.
